seo.titre: Exhibitor Offers – Route du Rhum 2026 Village
seo.description: Exhibit at the Saint-Malo or Guadeloupe village during the 2026 Route du Rhum. Discover our exhibitor spaces and visibility opportunities.

en.chapo: Less than a year before the start of the Route du Rhum - Destination Guadeloupe 2026, the organization officially opens the marketing of its Exhibitor Village offers, intended for professionals.
texte: These elements are designed to allow you to build your presence at one of the nautical events right now.

contact.texte: An email address is also dedicated for any questions or requests for further information.

sections.titre: Embark on the experience Route du Rhum - Destination Guadeloupe

f.altHaut: The race village in Saint-Malo: stands at the foot of the boats’ masts, under a rainbow
f.altStand: A visitor at an exhibitor’s stand in the village, beers and gift boxes on the shelves
